claim: The same seed and the same parameter changes at the same steps give identical observables, bit for bit, on one runtime.
derivation: This is the brief's example 'identical seed + events ⇒ identical observables (bitwise) on the same runtime'.
init depends only on the parameters and seed (E15), and a step only on the previous state and the parameters (E1–E11); neither reads a clock or an unseeded random source.
Applying the same changes before the same step indices therefore reproduces every state, and every observable, bit for bit.
